01.title: Median off-plan apartment: what the buyer pays under each offer
01.source: Source: median price from betterhomes; fee and totals are our calculation at 4% of the contract price.
01.alt: Stacked bars of the median apartment's price and DLD fee: no incentive AED 1,941,130 plus AED 77,645; fee waiver AED 1,941,130 plus nil; 4 per cent discount AED 1,863,485 plus AED 74,539
